summary: Black Titan Corp filed a Form 6-K on September 2, 2026, announcing that a senior unsecured convertible note issued to an institutional investor was fully converted into 2,924,082 ordinary shares. The note, issued January 16, 2026, had an original principal of $1,515,000 with a 10% original issue discount. Conversions occurred in tranches from May through August 20, 2026, fully satisfying all obligations. This is a routine disclosure of an already-completed conversion, not a new dilutive offering or special situation. The Securities Purchase Agreement remains in effect through January 16, 2029, with no additional notes issued. Watch for potential future note issuances under the agreement.
